B false: displacement not always A1+A2; it oscillates between ±(A1+A2) if in phase. A true? "波峰与波谷相遇处质点的振幅为 |A1-A2|" At point where crest meets trough? D false: crest-crest amplitude A1+A2, crest-trough amplitude |A1-A2|; crest-crest amplitude greater/equal, not less. So answer A.
